items.title: Otobüs bileti almak
items.situation: You are at the bus station. You want to go to another city today. Talk to the man behind the window.
items.situationTr: Otobüs garındasın. Bugün başka bir şehre gitmek istiyorsun. Gişedeki adamla konuş.
prompts: Say where you want to go.
Ask about the time of the next bus.
Ask how much the ticket is.
Say how many tickets you want.

usefulPhrases.en: I want to go to Bursa today.
What time is the next bus?
How much is a ticket?
Two tickets, please.
Where does the bus leave from?

items.title: Kafede ödeme yapmak
items.situation: You have finished your tea and cake in a cafe. Now you want to pay.
items.situationTr: Bir kafede çayını ve pastanı bitirdin. Şimdi ödeme yapmak istiyorsun.
prompts: Ask for the bill.
Say what you had.
Ask if you can pay with a card.
Say thank you and say goodbye.
promptsTr: Teşekkür et ve hoşça kal de.

usefulPhrases.en: Can I have the bill, please?
I had a tea and a piece of cake.
usefulPhrases.tr: Bir çay ve bir dilim pasta aldım.

usefulPhrases.en: Can I pay with a card?
Here you are.
Thank you very much. Goodbye.

items.title: Evdeki hayvan
items.situation: A friend asks about the cat in your photo. Talk about the animal in your house.
items.situationTr: Bir arkadaşın fotoğrafındaki kediyi soruyor. Evindeki hayvandan bahset.
prompts: Say what animal you have and its name.
Say what it looks like.
Say what it eats.
Say what it does all day.
promptsTr: Hangi hayvanın olduğunu ve adını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I have a small cat. Her name is Mia.
usefulPhrases.tr: Küçük bir kedim var. Adı Mia.

usefulPhrases.en: She is white and black.
She eats fish and rice.
She sleeps all day on my bed.
She is four years old.

items.title: İşe nasıl gidiyorsun
items.situation: A new friend asks about your morning. Say how you go to work or school.
items.situationTr: Yeni bir arkadaşın sabahını soruyor. İşe ya da okula nasıl gittiğini anlat.
prompts: Say how you go to work or school.
Say how long it takes.
Say what you do on the way.
Ask him the same question.
promptsTr: İşe ya da okula nasıl gittiğini söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I go to work by bus.
It takes about thirty minutes.
I listen to music on the way.
Sometimes I walk when it is sunny.
How do you go to work?

items.title: Bir hediye seçmek
items.situation: You are in a shop with a friend. You want to buy a present for your mother.
items.situationTr: Bir arkadaşınla dükkândasın. Annene bir hediye almak istiyorsun.
prompts: Say who the present is for.
Say what your mother likes.
Ask your friend what he thinks.
Say how much money you have.

usefulPhrases.en: It is a present for my mother.
She likes books and flowers.
What do you think about this one?
I have two hundred lira.
That one is too expensive.
